misprints.note: Grave accent printed over υ where the coronis/smooth breathing belongs.
Accent printed on the diphthong instead of on ο.

uncertain.note: The narrow letter between ε and ρ could be ι or τ. I read τ, which gives the attested word ῥάχετρον.
The space between 'till' and 'rygga' is very narrow. I kept it as two words.
